html:
BookKraft AI is a suite of ebook formatting and publishing tools built for indie authors. The short version: we got tired of watching good books fail to publish because of avoidable technical problems.

Here's the full story of what we built and why — the problem we kept running into, the decisions we made while building, and how each tool fits into the publishing workflow.

The Problem We Kept Seeing

Most ebook publishing problems aren't about the writing. They're about the file. Authors finish their manuscripts and then hit a wall of technical requirements: EPUB structure, OPF manifests, table of contents formatting, metadata standards, image size limits, CSS compatibility across devices.

None of this has anything to do with writing a good book. But getting it wrong means KDP rejections, Apple Books rejections, broken formatting on some devices, or a reading experience that undermines the book itself.

The pattern was always the same. An author finishes a manuscript, converts it to EPUB using Word or Calibre or an online tool, uploads it to KDP, and it publishes. Success — except the EPUB actually had structural errors that KDP silently ignored during its internal conversion process. Then the author tries to upload the same file to Apple Books or Kobo and gets a rejection with a vague error message. Back to square one, without knowing what went wrong or how to fix it.

We saw this happen repeatedly across the indie publishing community. The tools to prevent it existed in theory — EPUBCheck is a free validator, Sigil is a free editor — but using them required learning a technical toolchain that most authors didn't want to invest time in.

What BookKraft AI Is

BookKraft AI is a collection of sixteen web-based tools that handle specific ebook publishing jobs. They run in your browser. You don't install anything. Your files don't get stored on our servers for the free tools — processing happens entirely in your browser using JavaScript.

The tools fall into three categories:

Validation and quality checking:

  • EPUB Validator — runs the same structural checks that KDP, Apple Books, and Kobo use, giving you a prioritized error report before you upload anywhere
  • Word Cleanup Checker — scans your manuscript for the formatting problems that become EPUB errors during conversion
  • Cover Checker — verifies your cover image meets every platform's pixel dimension, aspect ratio, and file size requirements
  • Book Score — AI-powered analysis of your book's overall publishing readiness, from manuscript quality to metadata completeness

Formatting and conversion:

  • Full Manuscript Mode — converts your .docx or .txt to a valid EPUB 3.0 file with chapter detection and clean HTML in one step
  • EPUB Formatter — fixes common EPUB formatting errors in an existing file without requiring a full rebuild
  • TOC Generator — builds a properly structured EPUB table of contents from your chapter headings
  • Kindle Format Fixer — corrects encoding, punctuation, and CSS issues specific to Kindle formatting

Content and metadata:

  • Metadata Builder — generates correctly formatted metadata for KDP, Apple Books, IngramSpark, and Draft2Digital from a single form
  • KDP Keyword Finder — uses AI to identify the seven search keywords most likely to help readers find your book on Amazon
  • Blurb Writer — generates compelling back-cover copy from your manuscript summary and genre

The Design Decisions Behind It

Three decisions at the start shaped everything:

Free tools for the basics. EPUB validation, metadata building, cover checking, word cleanup, and manuscript conversion are all free with no account required. These are the tools every author needs — there's no good reason to put them behind a paywall. The free tools are not crippled demos; they're the same quality as the paid tools. We make money on AI-powered features that require inference costs, not on validation that runs entirely in your browser.

One-time pricing, not subscriptions. You don't need to pay monthly to publish a book. The AI-powered tools are available through a one-time Starter or Pro plan — you pay once and use the tools for as long as you need them. No subscription that stops working if you take six months off between books. No tier inflation where features you need get locked behind higher plans over time.

No learning curve for the core workflow. Every tool has a clear input and a clear output. Upload your file, run the tool, get your result. The validation report describes errors in plain language — "your OPF manifest references a file that doesn't exist" not "OPF-032: manifest item not found." The interface is simple because the underlying problems are already complex enough; the tool shouldn't add complexity on top of them.

How Each Tool Fits the Publishing Workflow

The tools aren't standalone utilities — they're designed to work in sequence as a publishing pipeline:

  1. Word Cleanup Checker → catches manuscript formatting problems before conversion
  2. Manuscript Mode → converts clean manuscript to valid EPUB 3.0
  3. Metadata Builder → generates correct metadata for all platforms simultaneously
  4. EPUB Validator → confirms the EPUB passes every platform's structural requirements
  5. Cover Checker → verifies the cover meets every platform's image specs
  6. KDP Keyword Finder + Blurb Writer → optimizes discoverability metadata before listing

You can enter the pipeline at any stage — if you already have an EPUB and just need validation, start there. If you already have good metadata and just need to check your cover, start there. The tools are independent enough to use individually, but they're most effective as a complete pipeline.

Who BookKraft AI Is Built For

BookKraft AI is built for indie authors who self-publish, for editors and book formatters who work with multiple author clients, and for authors in hybrid publishing arrangements who handle some of their own technical work.

It's not built for large publishing houses with in-house production departments — those operations have dedicated ebook production workflows and don't need browser-based tools. It's not built for developers who need API access to ebook processing — that's a different product category. The target user is someone who writes books and wants publishing tools that work without becoming a technical expert.

What's Coming Next

The gaps we're working to fill: better print-to-digital conversion for books that exist only as PDFs, series metadata management for authors with backlists of 10+ books, deeper WCAG accessibility compliance checking for authors publishing in markets that require accessibility standards, and audiobook metadata tools for authors moving into audio distribution.

If you have a specific ebook publishing problem that you think should have a tool but doesn't, reach out via the contact page. Most of the current tools exist because someone asked for them.

Pro Tips for Getting the Most From BookKraft AI

  • Start with the EPUB Validator on any existing file. If you have published books that were never professionally validated, run them through the validator. You may find errors that explain formatting complaints in reviews or poor display on certain devices.
  • Use the Word Cleanup Checker on every manuscript before conversion. Five minutes of cleanup saves 30 minutes of EPUB error fixing later. The cleanup step is easy to skip and almost always worth doing.
  • Save your validation reports. Before making any fixes to an EPUB, save the full validator report. If you introduce a new error while fixing an existing one, the saved report tells you what was there before versus what's new.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is BookKraft AI affiliated with Amazon, Apple, or any publishing platform?

No. BookKraft AI is independent. We don't have commercial relationships with KDP, Apple Books, Kobo, or any other publishing platform. The tools are built to help you publish successfully on all of them — we have no incentive to favor one platform over another.

Does BookKraft AI use AI for all its tools?

No. The five free tools — EPUB Validator, Metadata Builder, Cover Checker, Word Cleanup Checker, and Manuscript Mode — use in-browser processing without AI. They run as JavaScript in your browser, which is why your files never leave your device when using them. The AI-powered tools (Kindle Format Fixer, EPUB Formatter, KDP Keyword Finder, Blurb Writer, and Book Score) use Claude AI for the parts that benefit from language understanding and contextual analysis.

Can I use BookKraft AI for books in languages other than English?

Most tools are language-agnostic — the EPUB Validator, Metadata Builder, Cover Checker, and Manuscript Mode work correctly with any language. The AI-powered tools work best in English currently, with improving quality in Spanish, French, German, and Portuguese. For languages with right-to-left text (Arabic, Hebrew), the EPUB structural tools work but you'll need to add dir="rtl" attributes manually to your EPUB content after conversion.

Is my manuscript safe when I use these tools?

The free tools process files entirely in your browser — nothing is transmitted to our servers. For AI-powered tools, your text is sent to our AI provider (Anthropic) for processing and is not stored after your session ends. We don't use uploaded content to train models. Our complete privacy policy is at bookkraftai.com/privacy.

How does BookKraft AI compare to hiring a professional book formatter?

A professional book formatter brings design expertise, experience with complex layout scenarios, and accountability for the final product. BookKraft AI automates the technical compliance layer — making sure the EPUB is structurally valid, the metadata is correct, and the file passes platform validation. For authors who want design-focused formatting (custom fonts, chapter headers, decorative elements), a professional formatter and BookKraft AI complement each other: the formatter handles design, the validator confirms the output meets technical requirements before submission.
